browserAcceptance.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the committed transfer skipped intermediate reveals, left zero intermediate reveal nodes, announced the next choice, and restored focus to a decision option.

The veteran-no-offers career rendered the deterministic ending, P95 simulated-career percentile, total income, narrative, honors, and club trail at 390px and 1440px with zero document overflow.
A goalkeeper-legend replay rendered read-only deterministic replay, goalkeeper metrics, simulated-career percentile, total income, a 516-character self-contained URL, and no /api/ request.

A v2 active session was converted to a v1 envelope and reloaded. Startup retained the v1 bytes, wrote backup and receipt, produced schema v2 economy-v1 data, restored two choices and total income 40000, created one archive, and remained byte-stable on the next reload.

Archive UI created a branch at an earlier checkpoint with inherited income 20000 versus parent income 40000, exported 7618 bytes, deleted the branch, and imported the same career back with economy-v1 metadata.
The Enhanced native share-card dialog opened as a labelled modal, kept every Tab target inside, closed with Escape, and restored focus to Save share card.
